subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode universally prioritize the most constrained exhausted lane, or preserve a usable lane for percentage and highest-usage contexts while using exhausted-first selection for reset-focused display?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips an exhausted lane when another remains usable, while this PR reverses that established behavior for existing automatic-mode users; source correctness cannot determine the intended UX policy.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Preserve an actionable usable lane for percentage and highest-usage contexts while allowing reset-focused display to surface the binding exhausted lane.

options.title: Approve exhausted-first everywhere
options.body: Make the PR's universal most-constrained rule the new automatic-mode contract and explicitly accept the visible compatibility change.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Keep usable-first automatic selection and narrow the PR to independently desired cadence or reset-ordering repairs.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Preserve an actionable usable lane for percentage and highest-usage contexts while allowing reset-focused display to surface the binding exhausted lane.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the strongest available owner for deciding the permanent user-facing default semantics.
